<issue>Issue Title: [BUG] Knowledge not included in the agent planning process
Description:
### Description
Whilst all the tasks, agents, tools information is passed to the planning agent as part of the crew set-up, it seems that any knowledge which is pre-loaded isn't included - this could have important information which may guide the planning process decisions so I think it should be passed as part of this process.
### Steps to Reproduce
Setup a crew with knowledge and planning capabilities.
### Expected behavior
i would expect the knowledge to be included in the user prompt.
### Screenshots/Code snippets
n/a
### Operating System
Windows 11
### Python Version
3.13
### crewAI Version
0.83.0
### crewAI Tools Version
0.14.0
### Virtual Environment
Venv
### Evidence
see any user generated prompt with a agent or crew configured with knowledge.
### Possible Solution
Ensure both crew and agent knowledge sources are passed into the planning handler.
### Additional context
n/a
</issue>

Analysis:

1. The _set_knowledge method of the Agent class checks if the agent has knowledge_sources set. If so, it initializes a Knowledge object using those sources and some configuration (embedder_config, collection_name). This method is likely responsible for incorporating knowledge into an agent.

2. The _handle_crew_planning method in the CrewPlanner class creates the planning agent by calling _create_planning_agent, generates a task summary, creates a planner task, and executes it synchronously. This is the main method orchestrating the planning process.

3. The current _create_planning_agent method creates an Agent but does not set any knowledge sources on the agent before it is used in planning. Therefore, knowledge does not get passed to the planning agent.

Relationship to the bug:
- The bug states that knowledge pre-loaded in the crew setup is not passed to the planning agent in the planning process.
- Since the planning agent is created in _create_planning_agent and no knowledge is passed or set on the Agent, the knowledge is omitted.
- The _set_knowledge method in Agent allows to include knowledge sources, so this method needs to be invoked or the knowledge assigned when the planning agent is created.
- _handle_crew_planning calls _create_planning_agent; therefore, knowledge must be provided before or during this call if it is to be included in the planning.

Intended behavior:
- When creating the planning agent in _create_planning_agent, knowledge sources (likely those pre-loaded or associated with the crew) should be passed to or set on the Agent.
- This would involve extending _create_planning_agent to accept knowledge or have access to crew knowledge and assign it properly.
- The rest of the planning mechanism stays the same, but now knowledge is part of the planning agent context and influences planning decisions.
